edges: P. D. James commented on Agatha Christie's writing style regarding the guilty party in her stories.
Brian Aldiss claimed that Agatha Christie explained her writing process to him.
Agatha Christie employed a specific writing process as described by Brian Aldiss.
P. D. James commented on Agatha Christie's writing style regarding character guilt.
Brian Aldiss claimed that Agatha Christie wrote her books up to the last chapter and then decided on the unlikely suspect.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: John Curran's work describes different working methods for Agatha Christie's books, which contradicts Brian Aldiss's claim about Christie's writing process.
